title: A Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Testosterone Gel in Adult Hypogonadal Males
brief_summary: This is a phase 3, open-label, non-randomized, clinical trial to evaluate the efficacy and safety of FE 999303 (Testosterone gel) in adult hypogonadal males.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Males between 18-75 years of age
* Two fasting serum testosterone levels \<300 ng/dL

Exclusion Criteria:

* Previous use of the study drug
* History of prostate or breast cancer
* Prostate-Specific Antigen (PSA) ≥3 ng/mL
* Subject is sexually active and not willing to use adequate contraception
